description.7.0: Sets the local-damping factor to f for all nodes in the range (see the structure damping command). By default, f equals to 0.8.
description.9.0: Sets the local-damping factor to f for all nodes in the range (see the structure mechanical damping command). By default, f equals to 0.8.

verification: 7.0: availability verified against official FLAC3D 7.0 contents command index (https://docs.itascacg.com/flac3d700/common/sel/doc/manual/sel_manual/nodes/commands/cmd_structure.node.damping-local.html); syntax from official FLAC3D 7.0 detailed command page.
